authorization: Validation, timing review, then benchmarking using established conventions. Stop and ask the user only for genuinely new or unexpected findings.

review_policy.review_workers: Source-only static review; no compilation or execution by model workers
review_policy.timing_standard: Maximum per-rank duration or source-proven semantic equivalent; include QT-clustering distances and equivalent algorithmic preprocessing
review_policy.astra: Only very difficult unresolved cases; ask user if uncertainty remains

failure_policy: Retain ordinary generated-program failures without retry-until-pass. Preserve strict output comparison, including multi-rank output interleaving. Re-evaluate only affected observations for localized infrastructure/timing issues, never the unrelated corpus. Stop for new or unexpected findings.
storage: Clean source/pipeline worktrees on local /tmp ext4; persistent results and native validation build directories under home on local NVMe XFS, not NFS. Only compact evidence is eventually exported; builds/binaries excluded.
publication: No release or website publication is performed by this evaluation phase.
